Frequency Once per day

Duration 1 minute

You improve your warding technique to combat specific draconic enemies. Target a creature with the dragon trait that you can see. For the duration, your Dragonward protects you against one damage type of your choice that the creature you target is affiliated with based on its draconic lineage, such as the damage it can deal with its breath or similar draconic abilities rather than its physical claws, bite or tail attacks. You gain resistance to that damage type equal to your level for the duration. If you critically fail a saving throw or take a critical hit from an attack that would deal double damage to you, you can immediately expend the effect to take regular damage instead.
